card.name: Negation words after 'even' or comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as not, of, without, than and before that come right after 'even if', 'even in the absence', or a comparison like 'other than'. They introduce a contrasting or excluded condition.

modes.label: Even-if negation
modes.description: A negation word follows 'even if/when they are' or 'even in patients', marking an effect that holds despite a condition.
modes.example: may experience absence of scheduled (withdrawal) bleeding, even if they are<< not>> pregnant.

modes.label: Absence of / without
modes.description: 'of' or 'without' follows 'even in the absence' and leads into the missing item.
modes.example: Warfarin sodium tablets may increase the activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) test, even in the absence<< of>> heparin.

modes.label: Comparison than
modes.description: 'than' or 'the' follows 'other' or 'greater increase' in a comparison.
modes.example: Democrats may be even worse<< than>> Republicans at regulating Wall Street

card.plain: It fires on the small word that introduces a 'not', 'without' or 'other than' condition, especially after 'even'.
